**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation mechanic in either direction. The commercial terms in Section 3 (Fees; Payment) set a fixed 30% share of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold, with no requirement that the Company extend HDI any better terms given to third parties and no obligation to match third-party offers. Targeted searches for "most favored", "no less favorable", "favorable", "pricing", "discount", "other customers" and "right of first" surfaced nothing.

The only adjacent restriction is the Section 6.1 exclusivity covenant (the Company will not participate in similar Internet projects for Deerskin Products, and HDI has exclusive rights to the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained site). That is a scope/exclusivity term rather than a best-terms obligation, and per the no-double-flagging principle it belongs under the exclusivity rule, not MFN.

Since there is no MFN obligation burdening us, the document sits at the preferred position, so no edit was made.
